question: How can native Stream Deck controls be authored and updated without losing manual edits?
method: Inspected primary documentation and local version-3 profile structure; implemented independent tooling and synthetic failure tests. Documentation revision is the SHA-1 of the retrieved tool extract, not a Git commit. The ignored local run artifact retains that extract.
findings: Observed profiles contain reusable actions and separate page manifests.
adopted: Private capture, authored comparison, and journaled replacement.
rejected: Nested macros and assuming device success from rendering.

sources.title: Elgato Stream Deck Multi Actions
sources.license: Documentation referenced only; no text or code copied
findings: Native Multi Actions combine actions with optional millisecond delays.
Nested Multi Actions are not supported.
